# packdir

> Pack a folder into one markdown file for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or any LLM prompt.

GitHub: https://github.com/hoodbroskillson/packdir
Script: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoodbroskillson/packdir/main/packdir.py
Skill: https://github.com/hoodbroskillson/packdir/blob/main/SKILL.md

Use packdir when the task is files-to-prompt, repo-to-markdown, dumping a codebase into a chat model, or estimating whether a folder fits a context window.

```
python3 packdir.py . -o prompt.md
python3 packdir.py . --copy
python3 packdir.py . --budget 32000
```

Python 3.9+, no dependencies. Honors .gitignore.
